title: Small Town, Big Impact: Joyful Java thrives with the help of the UNI Small Business Development Center
summary_en: Joyful Java began when friends Angie Koop and Laura Dove transformed a neglected Dike building into a community‑focused coffee shop with guidance from the UNI Small Business Development Center. Now entering year two, the owners are expanding menus, retail offerings, and community events—proving passion and persistence fuel small‑town success.
title_cn: Small Town, Big Impact: Joyful Java thrives with the help of the UNI Small Business Development Center

title: Heading back to UNI? Here’s what to know about construction
summary_en: UNI, the City of Cedar Falls and others in the community have been working diligently to make improvements across campus to make your experience even better this fall. While much of that work is already complete, please note that some projects are still ongoing.

title: UNI’s Public Art Incubator leaves its mark across Iowa
summary_en: In a studio tucked inside the University of Northern Iowa’s Kamerick Art Building, summer is anything but quiet. Instead of empty classrooms, sparks are flying and sculptures are taking shape as students work alongside faculty on public art projects that will soon become permanent installations across Iowa. This summer, one of the biggest projects celebrates the Iowa State Fair.
title_cn: UNI’s Public Art Incubator leaves its mark across Iowa

title: 7 reasons to stop by the UNI Booth at the Iowa State Fair
summary_en: The University of Northern Iowa is heading to the Iowa State Fair, and you won’t want to miss what’s happening at our booth located in the Varied Industries Building. From Aug. 13-23, stop by to shop, connect and show your Panther Pride.
